task_description: Verify the White Desktop/GNOME baseline is present, add a general-purpose OS security baseline (including ClamAV, UFW, AppArmor, fail2ban, unattended-upgrades) wired into the general OS install rather than only the JWSTF path, add an 'improved Git' selectable component, and add a multi-select checklist step plus CLI-flag/env entry to the installer dialogs that surfaces every repo component and drives the selections through to actual installation.

verification.summary: No compile/build step applies to these shell/JSON/doc changes. `bash -n` passes (exit 0) for all six affected scripts (galactic-cherry-installer, install-os-security.sh, install-git-improved.sh, install-ubuntu-installer.sh, install-gnome-desktop.sh, install-jwstf.sh). installer/software-relative-meaning.json validates as JSON (python3 -m json.tool exit 0). The project has no runtime test harness (bash installer scripts); the project's actual validation is `bash -n` syntax checks plus grep-confirmed behavioral wiring, which were run and confirmed: step_components (--checklist) is inserted between step_desktop and step_disk; CLI flags --desktop/--enable/--disable/--non-interactive/--help and INSTALL_COMPONENTS/GC_COMPONENTS env are present; install-os-security.sh and install-git-improved.sh are wired into step_install with the guarded chroot pattern and conditioned on component_selected; JWSTF is now gated on component_selected 'jwstf' (was unconditional). No Dockerfile relevant to these scripts and network is restricted, so docker_build is skipped. apt/live-installer execution is not possible in this sandbox by design.
